checks.meaning: Assertions were run against actual local output independently; the count supports but does not replace the full-text judgments below.

judgments.subject: Approved copy transfer and roles
judgments.evidence: Runtime geumcheon-copy.json is byte-identical to approved 01f9e7… file. Exact title/H1/meta/OG/Twitter strings; hero opening and CTA roles; home venue/product section; directory card and administrative disclosures; full detail Markdown and all FAQ; shared navigation/inline/footer/404 text match the designated copy. Main body normalizes to exactly 2214 characters, with headings and paragraph/list/link text retained. No body paragraph or policy qualification was silently dropped.

judgments.subject: Funeral-only purchasing and claims
judgments.evidence: Four full cards appear on home and detail, in B201/B203/B205/B060 order with 59,000/79,000/109,000/149,000 KRW basic-price labels and exact corresponding official item URLs. Home has four additional hero previews of the same four products; detail has one B201 hero preview. These do not increase SKU variety. All eight full-card descriptions/alts and image-byte hashes match the approved contract. No celebratory cards or another region appear in the four generated HTML files. No new delivery, free-shipping, stock, affiliation, installation, collection, arrival or quality promise appears.

judgments.subject: Tone, empathy and provider voice
judgments.evidence: Read the full text in its actual section order. The first answer offers restrained help around condolence, budget and wording; no invented customer memory or emotional certainty. Budget comparison does not pressure spending or infer height/quality from the official product names. Required inputs stay in a single list. The provider-led consultation language and essential cost/timing/collection/refund limits remain balanced. Repeated navigation and concise calls to action are interface recurrence, not added instructional paragraphs.

judgments.subject: Pricing, materials and notice placement
judgments.evidence: Home includes exactly one approved full product notice after the four cards, and full inline-order text. Detail has no duplicate product notice; its retained article explains basic price versus total, possible delivery fee, mixed natural/artificial flowers, variations and no seller collection. Detail and directory each contain the exact compact inline-order text. 404 contains no inline banner or product notice.

judgments.subject: FAQ exposure and information completeness
judgments.evidence: Three question H3/answer P pairs match the approved complete answers, inside a normal section after source references. No details element, hidden attribute, aria-hidden=true or inline hiding exists on their ancestors. Inspected CSS has no FAQ hiding rule. FAQ additions remain reception versus dispatch, nonreligious ribbon wording, and backing-paper policy. This verifies open HTML presentation, not actual screen legibility or assistive-technology behavior.

judgments.subject: Facility anchors and directory
judgments.evidence: The two exact H2 targets #shillakwon-seoul and #doksan-funeral exist once and the directory facility links resolve to them. Directory has one article card, three legal-dong entries and ten administrative entries. Administrative rows and the explicit legal-basis explanation are inside a deliberately collapsed details disclosure; the summary is present. Nine partial relations render 일부. No empty hub or invented separate venue page is presented.

judgments.subject: Shared banner contract
judgments.evidence: Home/detail each contain message, budget, consultation in that order, separated by substantive content. Directory/404 have zero. Home exact module order is hero/message/venueSection/budget/productSection/consultation/inlineOrder. Each rendered alt and AI-image caption exactly matches approved copy; all three WebP file hashes match the approved assets. No new banner copy or regional substitution. Pixel layout and decoded image visual review are not performed here.

judgments.subject: Metadata, source and shared accessibility labels
judgments.evidence: One H1 per route; H2/H3 hierarchy has no jumps. Canonicals point to the exact Geumcheon home/directory/detail paths; 404 has none. All local links and fragments resolve in the inspected four artifacts. Source headings, seven destination labels/ARIA labels, source note and date render correctly. Home/directory social-image alt 꽃이랑 근조 3단 화환 is the source helper’s factual brand-plus-approved-product label; detail uses exact approved image alt. Florist schema names 꽃이랑, phone 1844-0644 and 서울 금천구, without another-region leakage. Decorative icon is aria-hidden; ARIA labelledby references resolve.
